prompts.name: Rules
prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset: one of three matched static illustrations for the "Past approaches" section of a clinical extraction demo.
Use the reference image for STYLE ONLY: refined physical paper sculpture, cream fibrous sheets, deep teal and sage cardstock, amber highlights, soft studio shadows and a white background. Portrait-leaning 4:5 composition, generous margins, clear top-to-bottom main flow, large readable serif lettering, white text on dark teal. No UI controls, robots, brains, scores or watermark.
Shared main input at top: cream paper labelled "Clinic letter" with grey filler lines and exact amber-highlighted quotation “Now, two each month.”
Shared output at bottom: cream record labelled "Structured data" with "Frequency: 2 per month".
This is a conceptual teaching example, not a measured output of a cited system. Include small footer "Illustrative approach". Keep all wording exact and avoid additional text.
Title "Rules". Main flow: clinic letter -> central physical rules board -> structured data. At left, a separate sage booklet labelled "Patterns + vocabulary" feeds the central board from the side. On the board show an embossed teal decision tree with clearly legible steps "Match phrase", "Check context", "Map frequency". The decision diamond reads "Current?" with a downward "Yes" path to mapping and a short side "No" path to "Skip". The illustrated current quotation follows Yes. Communicate explicitly supplied patterns and decisions, not learned training. Use crisp forward paper arrows and preserve clear connector routing.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset: one of three matched static illustrations for the "Past approaches" section of a clinical extraction demo.
Use the reference image for STYLE ONLY: refined physical paper sculpture, cream fibrous sheets, deep teal and sage cardstock, amber highlights, soft studio shadows and a white background. Portrait-leaning 4:5 composition, generous margins, clear top-to-bottom main flow, large readable serif lettering, white text on dark teal. No UI controls, robots, brains, scores or watermark.

This is a conceptual teaching example, not a measured output of a cited system. Include small footer "Illustrative approach". Keep all wording exact and avoid additional text.
Title "Trained models". Clearly distinguish training from use. In an upper-left side area, a small stack labelled "Labelled examples" contains three cream cards showing “every day” → “1 per day”, “twice a month” → “2 per month”, and “weekly” → “1 per week”. An arrow leads from these examples through a small paper element labelled "Training" to the central model. Central model is a sculpted teal layered-node network labelled "Trained model". A visually separate main vertical path runs from the NEW clinic letter at top through this trained model to structured data at bottom. Examples feed Training, Training feeds model, clinic letter feeds model directly at use time. Do not send the new letter through Training. Keep the diagram sparse, labels large, and side-training and main-use paths unambiguous.
